english: Take turns is on: the driver uses the page.
chinese: 轮流操作已开启：仅当前操作人可以使用此页面。

english: You can watch; people who can steer use the page.
chinese: 你可以查看；有操作权限的成员可以使用此页面。

english: Nothing is open yet. Pi, or someone who can steer, opens pages here.
chinese: 当前没有打开的页面。Pi 或有操作权限的成员可以在此打开网页。

english: Type an address above, such as localhost:5173, or ask Pi to open one.
chinese: 请在上方输入地址，例如 localhost:5173，也可以让 Pi 打开网页。

english: The file changed after this diff was read, so its other lines cannot be shown. Refresh to see them.
chinese: 读取差异后文件已更改，无法显示其余行。刷新以查看最新内容。

english: This file is too big to show its other lines here.
chinese: 此文件过大，无法在此显示其余行。

chinese: Pi 也修改过（当前没有未提交的更改）

chinese: 另有 {more} 个已改文件未在此列出。

chinese: 另有 1 个已改文件未在此列出。

chinese: 再次点击即可删除这个新文件

english: Tap again to throw these changes away
chinese: 再次点击即可放弃这些更改

english: Peek tiles on: sessions show here while they work, wait for you, or finish.
chinese: 会话速览已开启：正在运行、等待你处理或刚完成的会话会显示在这里。

english: PiP is not ready yet: your message waits in its box.
chinese: PiP 尚未就绪：你的消息仍保留在输入框中。

english: PiP is not ready yet. Try again in a moment.
chinese: PiP 尚未就绪，请稍后重试。

english: I keep an eye on your sessions and repositories: ask what’s going on, start new work, have me check back later, or watch a repository and act when something happens.
chinese: 我会关注你的会话和仓库：你可以询问进展、开始新工作、让我稍后跟进，或监视仓库并在出现新情况时采取行动。

english: PiP reads this when it finishes

chinese: PiP 会在下次暂停时读取

english: PiP has something new: open PiP
chinese: PiP 有新消息：打开 PiP

chinese: 进度条上限为模型的上下文窗口。

chinese: 上下文超过 {detail} 后，PiP 会在空闲时自动压缩。

english: PiP's idle compaction limit is {detail} tokens.
chinese: PiP 空闲时的压缩阈值为 {detail} token。

english: PiP is not ready yet. Try again in a moment.
chinese: PiP 尚未就绪，请稍后重试。
